summary: The Newburgh Enlarged City School District urges the FCC to reject proposals to terminate or limit E-Rate funding, emphasizing the critical role of E-Rate in maintaining affordable, reliable Internet access for schools and libraries. The school district expresses opposition to the sunset of E-Rate, citing the immediate financial impact on their budgets and the threat to equal educational opportunity. They argue that terminating E-Rate would force cuts to core educational programs and deepen the digital divide.

claims.requested_action: reject proposal to terminate or limit E-Rate Program
claims.argument: Terminating E-Rate would represent a cut to school and library budgets, jeopardizing years of progress building and upgrading networks
claims.evidence_quote: Terminating that support represents a cut to school and library budgets, jeopardizing years of progress building and upgrading those networks.
